title: Terminal Talk config.json
description: User-facing configuration for Terminal Talk. Edit ~/.terminal-talk/config.json to override defaults. VS Code and any editor that honours `$schema` / `json.schemas` will autocomplete these keys and validate values on save.

voices.description: Voice IDs for TTS playback. See app/lib/voices.json for the full 47-entry edge + 6-entry openai catalogue.

openai_clip.description: Used only when openai_api_key is set (premium fallback).

master_volume.description: Master output volume 0.0–1.0 (settings panel slider). Heartbeat clips stay at 0.45× this value, body/tool clips at 1.0×, so the mix ratio is preserved at any master level.

collapse_delay_sec.description: How long the toolbar stays expanded after the last interaction before it auto-collapses to the slim click-through strip. Playback keeps the collapsed strip coloured by the speaking session instead of pinning the full toolbar open.

auto_continue_after_click.description: When on, clicking a dot plays that clip and auto-continues through the remaining clips in time order — regardless of whether they were already heard. When off, a click plays only the clicked clip.

palette_variant.description: Colour palette variant. 'default' = the standard 8-colour palette; 'cb' = colour-blind-friendly (Paul Tol's 'muted' scheme, distinguishable under deutan/protan/tritan). EX5 / H3 Option 2.

tts_provider.description: Which TTS provider to try first. 'edge' = Microsoft edge-tts (free, no key, default). 'openai' = OpenAI TTS (paid, needs openai_api_key configured).

tts_fallback_provider.description: Which provider to try if the primary provider fails. Default 'edge' keeps fallback free and prevents hidden OpenAI credit spend when Edge is primary. Set to 'openai' only if you intentionally want paid fallback; monitor credits or enable OpenAI billing auto top-up/auto recharge. Set to 'none' to disable fallback.

dictation.description: Local Whisper dictation cleanup. The default local cleanup is free. Set cleanup_provider to 'openai' only if you intentionally want a paid LLM cleanup pass for Wispr-style punctuation, paragraphs, and list formatting.

cleanup.description: When true, clean raw Whisper output before copy/paste by removing filler words and applying spoken formatting commands.

cleanup_provider.description: 'local' runs deterministic no-cost cleanup. 'openai' sends dictated text to OpenAI using the saved API key and falls back to local cleanup on failure.

cleanup_model.description: OpenAI model used only when dictation.cleanup_provider is 'openai'.

keep_audio.description: When true, save each recorded dictation as a WAV beside the transcript for debugging and review.

save_timing.description: When true, save Whisper segment and word-pause metadata as a .segments.json sidecar.

speech_includes.description: Which markdown features get read aloud. Per-session overrides live in the sessions panel.

tool_calls.description: Narrate tool progress as ephemeral T-prefixed clips. Claude uses hook-derived tool calls; Codex uses rollout-derived tool events when available. Default true.

heartbeat_enabled.description: HB1 — global default. When Claude Code or Codex is actively working but the queue has been silent for 5 s, synthesise a spinner-verb ('Moonwalking', 'Pontificating') or thinking phrase as an ephemeral H-prefixed clip so you get audible confirmation the session is alive. Per-session heartbeat_enabled overrides can force on/off for one session.

update_check_enabled.description: Phase 8 (#32): when the install lives in a git checkout, periodically run `git fetch origin main` and surface a green badge on the gear icon if commits are ahead. Set false to disable network probes entirely. DMG / Homebrew installs no-op regardless because `git rev-parse` fails outside a repo.

update_check_interval_min.description: Minutes between update-checker probes. First probe fires 15 s after toolbar boot to stay out of the way of other startup spawns; thereafter the interval drives. Re-reads the config on each tick so a change reflects without a toolbar restart.

wake_words.description: Wake words the listener arms. Each entry is either a canned openWakeWord 0.6 model name (alexa, hey_jarvis, hey_mycroft, hey_rhasspy, timer, weather) OR an absolute path to a user-trained .onnx file under 5 MB. Invalid entries are skipped with a warning to _voice.log; if every entry is invalid the listener falls back to ['hey_jarvis']. Restart the toolbar (or kill the wake-word listener — the watchdog respawns it) for changes to take effect.

panels.description: UI panel persistence. Each sub-panel records its collapsed/expanded state and view mode so the toolbar restores exactly how the user left it.

transcript_expanded.description: Whether the transcript panel under the dot strip is open.

transcript_view.description: Which text view the transcript panel shows: 'spoken' (post-strip-for-tts, what the audio actually says) or 'original' (pre-strip markdown source).

create_session_default_kind.description: Which assistant is preselected in the Settings > Sessions create-session form.

create_session_defaults.description: Saved defaults for launching new Codex / Claude Code sessions from the toolbar.

create_session_window_placements.description: Optional advanced placement map for Settings > Sessions > Create session. Keys may be a label such as "Claude TT A", a slug such as "claude-tt-a", "kind:label", "kind:index", or "kind". Values may be a bounds string "x,y,width,height" or an object with windowPosition, windowSize, and windowBounds.

window.description: Last-saved window position. Managed by main.js; don't hand-edit.

openai_api_key.description: Optional — premium TTS fallback. Stored encrypted via Electron safeStorage after v0.3 (see D2).

selected_tab.description: Last-selected dot-strip filter tab. 'all' = unfiltered chronological view; otherwise a session shortId. Managed by the toolbar; falls back to 'all' if the previously-selected session is gone.

tabs_expanded.description: Whether the [▾ N idle] overflow row is expanded. Managed by the toolbar.

_comment.description: Free-form note. JSON has no native comments; _comment is ignored by the loader.
